question: Which of the following launched 'SAGE' initiative on 4 June 2021?

options.text: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Women and Child Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment **has started the SAGE (Seniorcare Aging Growth Engine) enterprise and SAGE portal for aged persons.
 
• The SAGE portal will be a **“one-stop access” **to senior care products and services by acceptable start-ups.
 
• The SACRED portal will **link senior citizens with job suppliers** in the private sector.
 
• The project is shaped by the guidance of the** empowered expert committee (EEC) report **on start-ups for seniors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NITI Aayog** gives a critical directional and strategic input to the development procedure of India.​ 
 
• **The Ministry of Education **is a ministry of the Government of India, in charge of the execution of the National Policy on Education.
 
• **Ministry of Women and Child Welfare** is the Scheme that envisages providing** shelter, food, clothing, and health as well as economic and social security for the women** victims of difficult situations which covers widows, destitute women, and senior women.
